{{CharInfobox| |color={{johto color}} |corecolor={{johto color light}} |bordercolor={{johto color dark}} |name=Director |jname=きょくちょう |tmname=Director |slogan=no |image=Radio Director Adventures.png |size=200px |caption=The Director in [[Pokémon Adventures]] |age=no |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Black |hair=Auburn{{tt|*|Pokémon Adventures}} |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Johto]] |trainer=no |game=yes |generation={{Gen|II}}, {{Gen|IV}} |games=[[Pokémon Gold and Silver Versions|Gold, Silver]], {{v2|Crystal}}, {{game3|HeartGold and SoulSilver|HeartGold, SoulSilver|s}} |leader=no |manga=Adventures |roundnum=PS105 |roundname=Smeargle Smudge |}} The '''Director''' (Japanese: '''きょくちょう''' ''Director'') is the head of the [[Goldenrod Radio Tower|Radio Tower]] in [[Goldenrod City]]. He appears in {{game5|Gold|Silver|Crystal|HeartGold|SoulSilver}}. ==In the games== During [[Team Rocket]]'s invasion of the [[Goldenrod Radio Tower]], the {{player}} meets with Team Rocket {{tc|Executive}} [[Petrel]] disguised as the Director. After being defeated, Petrel will reveal that the Director is in the [[Goldenrod Tunnel]]. After rescuing him, the real Director will give the {{jo|Card Key}}, that will provide access to the fifth floor, where Team Rocket's {{tc|Executive}}s are. Once Team Rocket has been conclusively defeated and disbanded, the Director will express his gratitude by awarding an item. In {{game3|Gold and Silver|Pokémon Gold|s}} and {{game3|HeartGold and SoulSilver|HeartGold|s}} he will give the [[Rainbow Feather|Rainbow Wing]], in {{game3|Gold and Silver|Pokémon Silver|s}} and {{game3|HeartGold and SoulSilver|SoulSilver|s}} he will give the [[Silver Feather|Silver Wing]], and in {{game|Crystal}} he will give the [[Clear Bell]]. The Director supposedly found the item given when the tower previously there was knocked down, and they are all used in summoning a [[Legendary Pokémon]], specifically the [[game mascot]]s {{p|Ho-Oh}}, {{p|Lugia}}, and {{p|Suicune}} respectively. ===Items given=== {{Itlisth|building}} {{Itemlist|Card Key|At the [[Goldenrod Tunnel]]|G=yes|S=yes|C=yes|HG=yes|SS=yes|display={{jo|Card Key}}}} {{Itemlist|Clear Bell|After defeating Team Rocket|C=yes}} {{Itemlist|Rainbow Wing|After defeating Team Rocket|G=yes|HG=yes|display=[[Rainbow Feather|Rainbow Wing]]}} {{Itemlist|Silver Wing IV|After defeating Team Rocket|S=yes|SS=yes|display=[[Silver Feather|Silver Wing]]}} {{Itlistfoot|building}} ===Quotes=== ====Pokémon Gold, Silver, and Crystal==== '''[[Goldenrod Tunnel]]''' :''"Who? {{color2|000|Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions|HeartGold and SoulSilver}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Eusine Mary Director Mirei Adventures.png|thumb|230px|right|Hiro (leftmost) in Pokémon Adventures]] The Director, known as '''Hiro''' (Japanese: '''ヒロオ''' ''Hirō''), appears as a recurring character in this series. ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===== He debuts in ''[[PS105|Smeargle Smudge]]'', where he invites {{adv|Gold}} to participate in a radio show at the Goldenrod Radio Tower. He is later seen with [[DJ Mary]] broadcasting events such as Gold's race against [[Whitney]], her visit to [[Mahogany Gym]] and the {{pkmn|battle}}s between [[Gym Leader]]s from [[Kanto]] and [[Johto]]. In [[PSs1]], he traveled to [[Mt. Silver]] to interview {{adv|Red}}, during which he grew inspired by his team. ====={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===== In ''[[PS337|Epilogue]]'', he makes a cameo appearance in one of the ships heading to the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. ====={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===== He appears with Mary as she is broadcasting the [[Pokéathlon]] events. When [[Lance's Dragonite]] suddenly attacks the area, Hiro ends up landing on its head. He is saved by Gold, who forces him to drive all the way to [[Ecruteak City]] so that he can see the [[Kimono Girl]]s. When he arrives at the Ecruteak Gym only to find it destroyed by {{adv|Arceus}}, Hiro decides to make a two-hour radio special to cover the events. Later, when the battle with Arceus ended, Hiro arrives, where he reveals his plan to Gold. Much to Gold's confusion, Hiro had recorded the events with a video camera despite working in the radio business. Hiro reveals that he plans on going into the television business, and has already thought up a show for children called [[Proteam Omega]], which is based on Red's {{cat|Red's Pokémon|team}}. It grew to be quite popular, and was broadcasted in at least Johto and [[Sinnoh]]. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hiro |pkmn=Dusknoir |type1=Ghost |img=Radio Director Dusknoir Adventures.png |epnum=PS453 |epname=All About Arceus II |desc={{p|Dusknoir}} is Hiro's only known Pokémon. It first appeared with its Trainer at the [[Ecruteak Gym]], right after it is destroyed by {{adv|Arceus}}.
